referenceFunction.generalComment:
Translated name: Erdgas, in Kraftwerk oder Heizkraftwerk Included processes: The module includes fuel input from the natural gas network, infrastructure, emissions to air, and substances needed for operation.
The module describes the operation of an average plant in the region. The plant is used for middle load with 4000 hours of operation at full capacity per year. The plant is assumed to operate 150000 hours during its lifetime. For the assessment of main characteristics and criteria emissions (SOx, NOx, particles) a bottom-up approach has been used and supplemented by typical emission factors in cases of data gaps (based on EEA/EPA). CO2, CH4 and N2O emissions have been derived from fuel type and IPCC emission factors. Airborne emission data has been updated for 2021, whereas other inputs and outputs come from the original dataset. The dataset consists on the collection of information about single plants. Base data on all major power plants and heat plants in 2021 have been integrated, to the extent possible. The size distribution of particles has been derived from non-linear calculations based on typical ratios for different total emission amounts based on CEPMEIP. Emissions of trace substances were derived from emission factors in the literature (EEA/EPA).
Geography: Data apply to the combustion in Slovenia. Technology: Average installed technology. Time period: Time of publications.
